draft_args.prompt: [Look: 1960s film look, office.] [An invented secretary types; at 4 s the paper scrolls out in invisible ink, she holds it to a lamp and words-shapes glow (unreadable); at 8 s she nods, eyes on the page.] Single shot: medium shot, 35mm, eye level, static camera, one continuous 10 s take. Eyelines: everyone looks at the product and each other, never into the lens; faces in profile or three-quarter. Motion carries on through the last half second. [Adults only, no kids. Invented characters; a named real person becomes only their moves and attitude, never their likeness. No gore; bloodstains on clothing are fine, no blood draining out. Nobody looks into the camera. Parody brands only; no real brands or personal names on screen.]
